values.note: ReserveAmerica, up to 9 months ahead, same day included. Peak season (mid-June to mid-September; 2027: June 18 - September 11, by area) takes 7-night reservations only, starting on the loop's own Friday, Saturday or Sunday, and only ONE 7-night reservation per name, address, email or phone. Non-peak minimum 2 nights, maximum 14 continuous nights then 48 hours away. Where less than the minimum stay is open, those nights go to walk-ins, first come first served. Register by 9 pm. Permit holder must be 21+ and present; reservations are non-transferable.

booking.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/hither-hills-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=297 ('up to 9 Month(s) in advance'; '7-night reservations only in Peak Season beginning on Friday, Saturday, or Sunday in designated loops'; 'During Non-Peak Season, the minimum stay is 2 nights'; 'In the event that less than the minimum stay is available ... stays will be permitted on a walk-in basis; first come, first serve'; LENGTH OF STAY; Season Dates 2027 peak windows), read 2026-10-21

values.note: ReserveAmerica lists 176 campsites (the park description says a 190-site campground); listed equipment lengths 20-40 ft (118 at 30 ft, 15 at 40 ft), every driveway back-in. The J Loop is tent-only, key-card entry, no generators.
